picks.editorial_note: A £5M UK government-backed trial using AI to reroute flights and cut contrail formation is a rare case of AI research translating directly into measurable climate action, with Cambridge, Imperial, and Google collaborating on real flightpath changes.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Penn's implantable Smart Neurostimulation System, built on decades of computational memory modeling, represents a genuine breakthrough toward treating memory loss with real clinical stakes.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: DOE's selection of a Fermilab-led team under the national Genesis Mission initiative signals a major federal bet on AI for particle accelerator science, with implications for how national labs prioritize AI infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to specific training data — has direct bearing on ongoing copyright and AI-accountability debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute pairs AI-driven high-throughput experimentation with industry resources to accelerate battery materials discovery, a critical bottleneck for clean energy.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: The $9M NSF-funded iDLab, linking NCSA, UCLA, and national HPC centers through a unified browser-based platform, expands equitable access to AI compute infrastructure nationally.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new neural-network compression method addresses a looming crisis in scientific data storage without sacrificing analytical detail, a practical win for AI-augmented experimental physics.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's computational infrastructure for the MOSAIC multi-modal microscope enables researchers to manage and interpret massive, heterogeneous imaging datasets, expanding what's scientifically observable.
picks.title: Building the Computational Mind for the “Swiss Army Knife” of Microscopes

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London's five-year center with Smith+Nephew aims to translate academic computer-vision research directly into surgical robotics products, a concrete academia-industry pipeline.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo's new research cluster combines an established AI drug-discovery platform with academic biomedical expertise, a notable industry-academia bet on AI-accelerated pharma research.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo
